claim_boundary: Passing supports a pre-registered external benchmark formulation-accuracy improvement. It does not prove semantic equivalence for every formulation or eliminate public-data contamination.

endpoint.definition: candidate solver status is optimal and objective matches the published solver outcome
endpoint.documentation_discrepancy: Pinned README prose says relative tolerance 1e-4, while pinned main/evaluation/problem_evaluator.py uses rel_tol=1e-5 and abs_tol=1e-6. The executable evaluator code wins.
endpoint.name: benchmark formulation accuracy

future_run_freeze: Only after the unchanged v7 development gate passes: bind the exact method, prompts, provider, public snapshots, runner, evaluator, request budgets, and a new explicit authorization.

joint_success_rule.category_spread: positive delta in >=4 of 7 categories and negative delta in <=1 category
